app_card_subtitle: Create original logo concepts from a brand brief
app_introduction: Turn a brand brief into an original logo. Download it or add it to a product.
app_details: Create original logo concepts for products, collections, and campaigns. Enter a brand name and creative direction, then generate a square logo inside Shopify admin. Optionally upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP reference to guide a substantially redesigned concept. Preview and download the result, or add it as a new product image while preserving existing media.
feature_list: Generate original logo concepts from brand briefs
Guide designs with optional reference images
Download results or add them to Shopify products

assets.feature_media_alt: A brand brief transformed into a downloadable logo ready for product media

screenshots.alt: Create an original logo from a brand name, creative direction, and optional reference image
Review and download a generated logo from the dedicated result page
Select a Shopify product and add the generated logo as new product media
